commits.message:
Make the matrix deployable on Vercel

The production build compiled, then failed because Vercel looked for a
root dist/ and the publishable site is only assembled by stage-site.sh.

npm run build now stages the site. vercel.json publishes site/, and the
same tree is mirrored to dist/ so the linked Vite preset still finds it.

Merge pull request #4 from jrmoyler/vercel-deploy

Make Ability Matrix deployable on Vercel

files.patch:
@@ -66,6 +66,8 @@ sh tools/stage-site.sh
 npx serve site
 ```
 
+`npm run build` does both steps. Vercel runs that command and publishes `site` (`vercel.json`). The same tree is copied to `dist` so a Vite preset that still expects `dist` succeeds. The hosted matrix loads the sandbox with `?bin=wasm`; staging renames models and HDRIs to `.wasm` and the sandbox bridge rewrites those requests.
+
 To work on the sandbox alone: `cd packs/sandbox && npm i && npm run dev`.
 
 Sandbox keys:

@@ -7,7 +7,7 @@
     "test": "node --test tests/*.test.mjs",
     "dev:atlas": "vite packs/atlas --host 127.0.0.1",
     "build:atlas": "vite build packs/atlas --base ./",
-    "build": "sh tools/build-all.sh"
+    "build": "sh tools/build-all.sh && sh tools/stage-site.sh"
   },
   "dependencies": {
     "three": "0.185.1"

@@ -18,3 +18,8 @@ done
 find "$OUT/packs" -type f \( -name "*.fbx" -o -name "*.glb" -o -name "*.hdr" \) -exec sh -c 'mv "$1" "$1.wasm"' _ {} \;
 for f in "$OUT"/packs/*/index.html; do sed -i -E 's/\.(fbx|glb|hdr)"/.\1.wasm"/g' "$f"; done
 du -sh "$OUT"; find "$OUT" -type f | wc -l
+# Vercel’s Vite preset publishes ./dist unless vercel.json is honored.
+# Mirror the staged site so either output directory succeeds.
+rm -rf "$ROOT/dist"
+mkdir -p "$ROOT/dist"
+tar -C "$OUT" -cf - . | tar -C "$ROOT/dist" -xf -

reconciliation.actualDelta: README explanation; npm build adds site staging; stage-site mirrors already-staged output into dist; added Vercel build/output configuration. Existing model/HDR .wasm staging renames predate this comparison.
